_doc: The shot holds act2-plan's direction notes ask for (docs/kb/story/beats/act2_ch1X_direction.md), for tools/audio/act1_playthrough.py --holds: script stem -> {camera id: the least seconds that shot holds}. A shot's first @wait is raised to its hold (or the hold is added when the shot has none), so a one-shot cue's gap is measured against the staged scene, not the script's floor. Only holds the notes state in seconds; ranges take their low end.
